label: Amber artifact imagery
reason: Artifact object imagery is an artifact identity/product pattern even when inserted into a listing rail.

label: Event Token Medallion imagery
reason: Badge/avatar identity assets are Event Token Medallions overlays/extensions, not event primary/gallery media.

label: Festival chronology media
reason: Dedicated festival records, chronology policy and media layout do not consume the PreviewEvent Event Media contract.

label: Interest-club cover media
reason: Dedicated club cover/fallback belongs to club identity and catalog semantics, not event media.

label: Transport map and icon media
reason: Transport maps/icons communicate route guidance inside a separate transport feature and do not consume event image semantics.

behavior_policy: Provider-controlled source ratio today; deterministic 1200x630 remains required.
definition: Current Event Detail metadata binding to a source image and optional intrinsic dimensions.
explicit_non_goals: Not the same as generated native-share canvas and not proof of provider crop/accessibility behavior.
source_classification_criteria: Event route selects event.image_url and matching asset.

behavior_policy: Implemented vertical share is 4:5; durable OG 40:21 and square 1:1 are required but missing.
definition: Media source/pass-through or generated event-branded image used by native share and social preview flows.
explicit_non_goals: Not an in-page hero/card ratio authority and not an accepted durable pipeline.
source_classification_criteria: visual_only may compose; OCR/unknown pass original; OG is currently source metadata.

behavior_policy: Listing/card/rail policies remain separate until evidence supports a contract boundary.
definition: Media used in ListingEventCard, mobile listing rail, Search flow or source-only list item.
explicit_non_goals: Not one ratio token or automatic merge of Search, listing card and rail.
source_classification_criteria: Consumer placement, not inferred from image dimensions.

behavior_policy: 4:5, 5:4, source or packed-row ratio remains consumer input.
definition: Media region inside canonical EventCard and its runtime clones.
explicit_non_goals: Not equivalent to compact ListingEventCard, hero, gallery or global image component.
source_classification_criteria: EventCard source or clone, including home, discovery, feed, favorites and collections.

behavior_policy: Consumer-specific viewport/source geometry and photo/poster policies.
definition: Primary event or home-feature media in a hero/large-frame composition.
explicit_non_goals: Not an asset semantic; mobile/desktop compositions are not automatically one component identity.
source_classification_criteria: Placement selected by HomeHeroTalk, EventHero or DesktopEventPage consumer.

behavior_policy: Safe photos use P/S/W/L tokens locally; documents source ratio.
definition: Specialized perspective deck and source-order gallery for exhibition discovery.
explicit_non_goals: Not automatic proof for a generic Event Media component or global ratio tokens.

behavior_policy: Rendered geometry is consumer-specific; source order and semantic fit must be retained.
definition: Small preview media that selects a gallery source.
explicit_non_goals: Not all preview rails are one accepted component; lab rail is evidence-only.
source_classification_criteria: Desktop split/editorial/companion preview, EventMediaRail or mobile listing gallery cell.

behavior_policy: Current implementations use unconditional cover and fail closed as an unresolved policy gap; this placement grants no general crop authority.
definition: Decorative related-event image used behind a terminal recommendation CTA in a viewer or gallery.
explicit_non_goals: Not primary gallery media, an EventCard preview, or share/social output; placement does not classify the underlying asset.
known_gaps: asset semantics, focal/safe area and broken convergence absent
source_classification_criteria: Terminal recommendation placement selected by EventHero or DesktopEventPage; source semantic metadata is not serialized.

behavior_policy: Source-ratio contain with 2:3 only as missing-dimension fallback.
definition: A positively classified event-identity poster shown whole beside a separate primary photo/content composition.
explicit_non_goals: Not every OCR asset and not a component identity solely because it occupies a pane.
source_classification_criteria: Desktop companion selection requires event_identity_poster plus qualified separate media; separate/arrival are composition variants.

behavior_policy: Source/intrinsic geometry; photo/document fit remains per slide; stable viewport and accessible controls required.
definition: Full-view source-order event media in modal or efficient gallery/viewer.
explicit_non_goals: Not the same identity as a thumbnail rail or poster companion.
source_classification_criteria: Gallery/viewer placement with source semantic metadata.

behavior_policy: Contain/natural by default; only a consumer-specific, positively evidenced bounded exception may crop.
definition: Text-bearing or positively classified non-photo document media.
explicit_non_goals: OCR is not poster identity and does not authorize a shared document component or global ratio.
source_classification_criteria: image_text_mode=ocr_text and/or roles attendee_information, program_or_schedule, wayfinding, sponsor_or_brand, unknown_document.

behavior_policy: Default whole/source-ratio contain; companion is a placement, not the poster identity.
definition: A positively classified event-identity poster with portrait source geometry.
explicit_non_goals: Not all portrait images, OCR images or artwork; not a universal 2:3 frame.
source_classification_criteria: media_role=event_identity_poster plus width/height<1; OCR alone cannot promote poster identity.

behavior_policy: Fail closed as protected text/document until an owner-approved taxonomy exists.
definition: Meaning-bearing artwork whose embedded text must remain readable but whose event role may not be an identity poster.
explicit_non_goals: Must not be inferred from OCR keywords, portrait shape or aesthetic similarity.
source_classification_criteria: No dedicated pinned enum; image_kind=poster|mixed and OCR evidence are insufficient to distinguish identity, schedule, sponsor or artwork.

behavior_policy: Fail closed toward whole/contain presentation; never infer photography from geometry.
definition: Image whose text/semantic evidence is missing, pending, stale or errored.
explicit_non_goals: Not a temporary license to crop or a separate accepted component identity.

behavior_policy: May cover only under the consumer policy; semantics do not choose a ratio or global crop rule.
definition: A source image classified as visual-only event photography or explicitly reviewed no-OCR visual media.
explicit_non_goals: Not equivalent to portrait poster, OCR document, artwork, hero placement or a component identity.
source_classification_criteria: image_text_mode=visual_only; positive event_photo/crop evidence required where a consumer needs crop permission.

behavior_policy: EventCard converges to typographic fallback; ListingEventCard, primary, galleries, companions and rails have differing/incomplete behavior.
definition: Runtime state after a selected source fails to load/decode.
explicit_non_goals: Not synonymous with no-image fallback until consumer-specific runtime evidence proves convergence.
source_classification_criteria: Image error event or failed source fetch.

behavior_policy: Search 5:4, listing/rail consumer geometry, Favorites non-ratio grid; no global skeleton ratio.
definition: Reserved geometry while asynchronous media or dynamic results load.
explicit_non_goals: Not one global skeleton component and not applicable merely because an image is lazy.
source_classification_criteria: Consumer has a genuine wait or image decode state; static SSG markup alone does not require artificial skeleton.

behavior_policy: Typed art is 1280x1280 contain/decorative; generic fallbacks keep consumer geometry.
definition: Deterministic media absence state; typed EventFallbackArt exists for selected event categories and generic fallbacks exist elsewhere.
explicit_non_goals: Not evidence that missing and broken states converge everywhere.
source_classification_criteria: No usable event media after consumer selection/quality gate.
